name: registry-limits
description: Registry limits are ST_BAD_REQUEST (wire.md 4.1, 4.3: "name too long, data too large, invalid path, too deep: `ST_BAD_REQUEST`"): a key name of 255 UTF-16 units is accepted and 256 refused; a value name of 16383 accepted and 16384 refused; a rename leaf of 256; a key 512 components below `\Registry` accepted, 513 refused. Limits count UTF-16 code units, so a character above U+FFFF counts as two. Refused requests change nothing.

steps.note: 127 characters of two units and one more: 255 units
